crop.title: Crop Recommendation
crop.subtitle: The AI model analyzes your live soil and climate data to suggest the best crop.
crop.condition_data_note: Rice and Sugarcane use hand-curated agronomic ranges. The other crops use ranges derived from the same dataset behind Crop Recommendation; that dataset has no soil moisture column, so soil moisture for those crops uses a general water-need heuristic instead.

fertilizer.title: Fertilizer Recommendation
fertilizer.subtitle: The AI model analyzes your crop, soil type, and nutrient levels to suggest the best-fit fertilizer.
fertilizer.disclaimer: Prototype decision-support only — not a certified agronomic prescription. Field and agronomic validation are required before application.

soil_health.title: Soil Health
soil_health.subtitle: A transparent, rule-based score derived from your live soil and sensor readings.
soil_health.scoring_note: Score is based on Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Soil Moisture, Soil pH, Temperature and Humidity.
soil_health.not_scored: Not scored — shown for reference only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hardware_hint: Connect your real ESP32-S3 sensor node, ESP32-S3 motor controller and AI-Thinker camera. When enabled, live sensor readings, robot commands and the camera feed come from these devices instead of the simulator.

landing.hero_subtitle: AgriNova watches your soil, weather, and crops around the clock, predicts what they need next, and automates the response — irrigation and a robot to run it all — in your own language.
landing.features_title: Everything your farm needs, one dashboard
landing.features_subtitle: Built around the same sensors and automation a real ESP32-based farm rig uses, so it works today with a simulated feed and drops straight in when your hardware is ready.
landing.feature_monitoring_body: Soil moisture, temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind, and NPK levels streamed to your dashboard in real time.
landing.feature_crop_body: A trained model reads your live soil and climate data and suggests the best-fit crop from 22 possibilities, with confidence scores.
landing.feature_irrigation_body: A prediction model tells you exactly when to irrigate, with a plain-language explanation — run it in Auto or take manual control.
landing.feature_robot_body: Drive your field robot, pan and tilt its camera, and capture snapshots — all logged so you can review what happened and when.
landing.feature_assistant_body: Ask questions in plain language and get answers grounded in your farm's actual live data, weather, and recommendations.
landing.feature_alerts_body: Get notified the moment irrigation starts, rain is detected, a sensor reading changes, or the robot disconnects.
landing.feature_languages_body: The full dashboard — not just labels — works in English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Punjabi, and Malayalam.
landing.how_title: Up and running in three steps
landing.step1_body: Tell us your region, field size, soil type, and current crop. It takes about a minute and powers every recommendation you'll see.
landing.step2_body: Sensor readings start flowing to your dashboard immediately. Irrigation runs itself in Auto mode.
landing.step3_body: Check crop recommendations, irrigation predictions, and alerts — or just ask the assistant what it thinks you should do next.
landing.cta_title: Ready to see your farm live?
landing.cta_subtitle: Create an account, set up your farm in a minute, and watch the dashboard come alive.
